name: dvb
description: Native DVB tuner support: enumerate TBS and other Linux DVB adapters on any streaming server, define satellite/cable/terrestrial transponders, scan them for services, and import the ones you pick as live channels fed by DVBlast. Encrypted services can be descrambled in place through a NEWCAMD or CS378X card server. Uses the kernel DVB API, so no Astra or TVHeadend is required.
